error[L0303]: `view` is not mutable, so it may not be written
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/inout-mut-slice-parameter-drops-inout/program.ldn:7:10
  |
7 |     fill(view)
  |          ^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/inout-mut-slice-parameter-drops-inout/program.ldn:6:5
  |
6 |     view: []mut f64 = store
  |     ^^^^ declared here
  = note: [0900]: `inout` lets the callee replace the caller's slice, so the binding passed must be `mut`. A `[]mut` parameter writes the elements without it: remove `inout` from the parameter, or declare `view` with `mut` if the callee does replace the slice.
  = help (guess): remove `inout`
